verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents public programmatic interfaces: client libraries in multiple languages (C++/Python) that expose its core functionality, and a `ros2` CLI with sub-commands for nodes, topics, services and parameters (e.g. `ros2 topic pub`). It also documents topic, service and action interfaces for sending goals, getting feedback and cancelling, plus a Python bag API, so an agent can drive the system through documented APIs. Community users independently value the CLI tooling. Missing for 10: agent-oriented integration evidence (machine-readable CLI output, network/HTTP access without joining the DDS graph), and hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API.
